department: James Tarpo Jr. and Margaret Tarpo Department of Chemistry

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for fall entry; there is no spring or summer entry.
deadline.quote: Application Deadlines Fall Spring Summer December 1 No Entry No Entry

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages that could be fetched.

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages that could be fetched.

entry_route.value: The department admits to the PhD (it is not taking MS applicants); applicants from outside the US need the equivalent of a US bachelor's degree before starting.
entry_route.quote: The Tarpo Department of Chemistry is not actively seeking Master’s Degree applicants at this time, and students who apply for the MS program will be declined. | Students enrolled in programs outside of the United States must complete the equivalent of a United States Bachelor’s Degree prior to matriculation.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires TOEFL iBT 88 overall (Speaking 23 preferred) for tests before 21 January 2026, or 4.5 on the new scale for later tests.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: Internet-Based Test (IBT): Minimum Overall Required Score: 88 (For exams taken before January 21, 2026) | TOEFL: Internet-Based Test (IBT): Minimum Overall Required Score: 4.5 (For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: Chemistry requires IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with Speaking 7 (6.5 considered for exceptional applicants).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic Module): Minimum Overall Required Score: 7
